help_text:
usage: admin_cli.py [-h] [--api-url API_URL] [--region REGION]
                    {topics,articles,feedback-config,inbox,approve,pipeline-config,review,lineage,stats,moderation,failed-executions,security,sign-ins,models,model-config,refinements,equipment} ...

BloggerBear admin operator CLI

positional arguments:
  {topics,articles,feedback-config,inbox,approve,pipeline-config,review,lineage,stats,moderation,failed-executions,security,sign-ins,models,model-config,refinements,equipment}
    topics              Manage Topics
    articles            Manage articles
    feedback-config     When BloggerBear takes feedback: lockdown, rate limit, daily limit, per-
                        article limit
    inbox               What is waiting for you (articles, prompt changes, failed runs), at a
                        glance
    approve             Go through what is waiting for you, one keystroke each: y approve, r
                        reject, z skip, v read it all, q quit. Up to 30 at a time; run it again
                        for the next batch
    pipeline-config     Pipeline-wide settings (the default research interval, the draft review
                        mode, who may reach the assistant)
    review              How the fresh-data review of drafts is doing
    lineage             Audit and repair article lineage/cost data
    stats               Observability: one-time catch-up jobs
    moderation          Manage the moderation queue
    failed-executions   View daily_cycle executions that exhausted their retries
    security            Security incidents: list them, move them along, or open one by hand
    sign-ins            Sign-ins to the operator's assistant: the log, and unlocking a user
    models              Manage the AI model registry
    model-config        Manage the global default/fallback model
    refinements         Manage prompt refinements
    equipment           What the bear wears: armor (global guidance), rings (topic guidance), the
                        backpack

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --api-url API_URL     Admin API base URL (default: $BLOGGERBEAR_ADMIN_API_URL)
  --region REGION       AWS region (default: $AWS_REGION / $AWS_DEFAULT_REGION)

topics get.help_text:
usage: admin_cli.py topics get [-h] topic_id

positional arguments:
  topic_id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

arguments.name: --adapter
arguments.help: Adapter key (default: web_search -- independent web research on the topic's name)

arguments.name: --editorial-goals-json
arguments.help: Topic-specific goal, e.g. '{"primary_focus": "...", "exclusion_criteria": "..."}'; omit to inherit the adapter/global default

arguments.name: --research-cadence
arguments.help: EventBridge Scheduler expression, e.g. 'rate(1 hour)' (default: rate(1 hour))

arguments.name: --research-interval-hours
arguments.help: Whole hours between real research runs (the --research-cadence schedule is only the heartbeat). Omit to inherit the pipeline-wide default

arguments.name: --review-mode
arguments.help: This topic's fresh-data review mode; omit to inherit the pipeline-wide mode

arguments.name: --daily-cadence
arguments.help: EventBridge Scheduler expression, e.g. 'cron(0 9 * * ? *)' (default: cron(0 9 * * ? *))

arguments.name: --daily-timezone
arguments.help: IANA zone the daily cron is read in (default: Australia/Sydney)

arguments.name: --model-id
arguments.help: Pin this topic to one Bedrock model (overrides the global default); '' clears it

arguments.name: --fallback-model-id
arguments.help: Model to retry with if this topic's primary model call fails; '' clears it

arguments.name: --model-candidates
arguments.help: Comma-separated model IDs to rotate between -- one is picked at random per daily run, ahead of --model-id; '' clears rotation

                        Topic-specific goal, e.g. '{"primary_focus": "...", "exclusion_criteria":
                        "..."}'; omit to inherit the adapter/global default

  --research-cadence RESEARCH_CADENCE

  --research-interval-hours RESEARCH_INTERVAL_HOURS
                        Whole hours between real research runs (the --research-cadence schedule is
                        only the heartbeat). Omit to inherit the pipeline-wide default
  --review-mode {off,shadow,enforce}
                        This topic's fresh-data review mode; omit to inherit the pipeline-wide
                        mode

                        EventBridge Scheduler expression, e.g. 'cron(0 9 * * ? *)' (default:
                        cron(0 9 * * ? *))
  --daily-timezone DAILY_TIMEZONE
                        IANA zone the daily cron is read in (default: Australia/Sydney)
  --model-id MODEL_ID   Pin this topic to one Bedrock model (overrides the global default); ''

  --fallback-model-id FALLBACK_MODEL_ID

topics delete.help_text:
usage: admin_cli.py topics delete [-h] topic_id

positional arguments:
  topic_id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

arguments.name: --no-wait
arguments.help: Don't poll for completion after triggering -- just fire the request and return immediately (the old behavior). Default is to wait and report when the pipeline has actually finished, since the trigger itself is asynchronous.

arguments.name: --force
arguments.help: daily_cycle only: write an article from the whole last-24h window even if the topic already has one since (the default is to write only from findings newer than its last article, so a repeat run with nothing new is a no-op)

topics trigger.help_text:
usage: admin_cli.py topics trigger [-h] --pipeline {research_tick,daily_cycle} [--no-wait]
                                   [--force]
                                   topic_id

positional arguments:
  topic_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pipeline {research_tick,daily_cycle}
  --no-wait             Don't poll for completion after triggering -- just fire the request and
                        return immediately (the old behavior). Default is to wait and report when
                        the pipeline has actually finished, since the trigger itself is
                        asynchronous.
  --force               daily_cycle only: write an article from the whole last-24h window even if
                        the topic already has one since (the default is to write only from
                        findings newer than its last article, so a repeat run with nothing new is
                        a no-op)

articles.help_text:
usage: admin_cli.py articles [-h] {publish,unpublish,rewrite,feedback-lock,feedback-unlock} ...

positional arguments:
  {publish,unpublish,rewrite,feedback-lock,feedback-unlock}
    publish             Force-publish an article regardless of its current status
    unpublish           Take a published article down: delete its page, mark it rejected, remove
                        its musings and clear the CDN cache
    rewrite             Rewrite an article to fix what you say is wrong with it. A published
                        article stays up until its rewrite is ready, then comes down; the rewrite
                        goes through the reviews again and waits in the inbox
    feedback-lock       Stop taking feedback on one article (its feedback_locked flag, set to
                        true)
    feedback-unlock     Take feedback on one article again (feedback_locked false). An article
                        locked because it reached its limit also needs --reset-count, or it stays
                        at the limit

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: admin_cli.py feedback-config get [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

feedback-config set.help: Set feedback settings (any of them; a setting not sent is unchanged)

arguments.name: --locked-down
arguments.help: true stops taking feedback site-wide (the page says so); false reopens; '' clears

arguments.name: --lockdown-reason
arguments.help: What the page says while locked down (up to 100 characters); '' clears it

arguments.name: --rate-limit
arguments.help: At most this many pieces of feedback per rate window (default 20); '' clears it

arguments.name: --rate-window-minutes
arguments.help: The rate window, in minutes (default 5); '' clears it

arguments.name: --daily-limit
arguments.help: At most this many a day, resetting at the start of the day (default 100)

arguments.name: --article-limit
arguments.help: At most this many on one article before it is locked (default 50)

arguments.name: --screening-limit
arguments.help: At most this many comments a day are sent to the model check (default 300). Rejected feedback does not count against the other limits, so this bounds its cost

arguments.name: --verification-required
arguments.help: true (the default) requires the token from the feedback-status call on every submission; false switches that off, in an emergency; '' clears it

arguments.name: --token-delay-min-ms
arguments.help: A token becomes valid at least this many ms after it is issued (default 500)

arguments.name: --token-delay-max-ms
arguments.help: ...and at most this many (default 2000); each token gets a random time between

arguments.name: --pow-threshold-percent
arguments.help: When the site is this percent full (of its daily or rate limit), tokens need proof of work (default 70)

arguments.name: --pow-difficulty-bits
arguments.help: How much work: leading zero bits, about a second or two at 16 (default 16); 0 = never

arguments.name: --daily-timezone
arguments.help: Where a day starts, an IANA zone (default Australia/Sydney)

pipeline-config set.help: Set pipeline-wide settings (send any of them; a setting not sent is unchanged)

arguments.name: --research-interval-hours
arguments.help: Whole hours between real research runs (1-168); '' clears it (back to 1)

arguments.name: --review-mode
arguments.help: Fresh-data review of drafts: 'shadow' runs and records it without changing any outcome (the default), 'enforce' acts on it (revises minor problems, holds major ones), 'off' skips it; '' clears it (back to the default). A topic's own --review-mode overrides this

arguments.name: --review-on-unavailable
arguments.help: In enforce mode, when the review could not run: 'hold' the article for a person (the default) or 'note' the gap and publish; '' clears it

arguments.name: --assistant-access
arguments.help: Who may reach the operator's assistant: 'open' any signed-in caller from anywhere (the default), 'allowlist' only from the operator's addresses, 'off' nobody; '' clears it (back to open). Applies from the next request, no deploy

  --assistant-access {open,allowlist,off,}

equipment.help_text:
usage: admin_cli.py equipment [-h] {list,equip,create,announce,delete,bump,repair,unequip} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,equip,create,announce,delete,bump,repair,unequip}
    list                Show every slot, the rings, and what is in the backpack
    equip               Wear an approved refinement (from the backpack or elsewhere); it replaces
                        what is in the slot
    create              Make a new piece of gear yourself and (by default) put it on. With no
                        --text it asks you what it needs, one question at a time
    announce            Post a loot drop to the Musings for a piece of gear (again, if it was
                        already announced)
    delete              Delete a piece of gear for good (it asks first). Articles written with it
                        keep their record
    bump                Raise a piece of gear's rarity (only up): a higher maximum durability, one
                        step by default
    repair              Restore a piece of gear's durability (all of it by default), never above
                        its maximum
    unequip             Take a worn refinement off; it goes to the backpack and is no longer used
